SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME, TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_1 AS QUOTATION_NO, KEY_2 AS QUOTATION_SEQ, KEY_3 AS REVISION FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'QTHDDOWN' AND TARGET IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID='KOL3') AND KEY_10 IN (' ','N') GROUP BY DOC_NAME, TARGET, KEY_1, KEY_2, KEY_3
